units.rawText: These kids are my aides and my friends. See, all of them are adorable, no?

units.rawText: Even if everyone's neural capacity isn't ideal right now, I'll make everyone as intelligent as I am one day—that's something I promised to everyone, and something I had the chance to do in the past, but never managed.
